nodes.label: Coach Mike (virtual AI coach)
nodes.rationale: Vision: motivate via push notifications and voice, greet by name, follow up on missed days, generate a personalized routine in Plan. Scripted chats today are not connected to the AI chatbot; answers are predefined options only.

nodes.label: generatePlan(profile) mock generator
nodes.rationale: Deterministic rule-based mock plan; designated integration point for the future AI.

nodes.label: GPS Run Tracking (background location)
nodes.rationale: Background location needs a development build; it does not work in Expo Go.

nodes.label: Plan / Workout model (plan.ts)
nodes.rationale: Dated workouts of steps and repeat groups in meters/seconds/sec-per-km; plain JSON so an AI can produce it.

nodes.label: planOnboardingScript.ts (Mike's copy, questions, planDayMessages)
nodes.rationale: All of Mike's copy lives in one pure TypeScript script file (no React).

nodes.label: Plan Screen (Week / Month views of 4-week plan)
nodes.norm_label: plan screen (week / month views of 4-week plan)

nodes.label: RunnerProfile model (runnerProfile.ts)
nodes.rationale: Stores stable option ids and metric values, never display labels, so copy can change without breaking saved data.

nodes.label: runtimeVersion appVersion policy
nodes.rationale: eas update only reaches builds made with the matching app version.

nodes.label: Animated API with Apple-style easing
nodes.rationale: Use React Native Animated with Easing.bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) for smooth, consistent Apple-style motion.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: type(scope): imperative summary, ~72 chars, English, body explains what and why; one logical change per commit keeps history easy to understand.

nodes.label: Use Design Tokens from src/theme
nodes.rationale: Colors, typography, spacing and radius come from tokens instead of hardcoded values for consistency.

nodes.label: Avoid Third-Party Libraries
nodes.rationale: Only add libraries when strictly necessary.

nodes.label: Reuse src/components UI
nodes.rationale: Avoid duplicating UI by reusing shared components.

nodes.label: Final Step Release Workflow (typecheck, bump, commit, push, report)
nodes.norm_label: final step release workflow (typecheck, bump, commit, push, report)
nodes.rationale: npx tsc --noEmit must pass; separate chore(release) commit; never force push; never run eas update.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning Policy (expo.version source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: semantic versioning policy (expo.version source of truth)
nodes.rationale: app.json expo.version is the single source; package.json kept in sync. MAJOR bumps require asking the user first.

nodes.label: Storage modules (profileStorage, planStorage)
nodes.rationale: Small get/save/clear modules backed by AsyncStorage; each is the only file to change when data moves to a real database.
